title: Tesla makes a move on Southeast Asia's largest EV market. A homegrown giant awaits
summary_full: Tesla recently set up a subsidiary in Vietnam, taking a step toward a potential entry into a fast-growing EV market dominated by homegrown rival VinFast.
summary_public: Tesla recently set up a subsidiary in Vietnam, taking a step toward a potential entry into a fast-growing EV market dominated by homegrown rival VinFast.
